about: His & Hers episode scripts (comic series; episode 1 was the original "Golf Heist" video about a new driver). Panels from data/heist-panels.json. 'box' and 'to' are fractions of the panel picture (outside 0-1 = above/below a framed panel): where the bubble sits and whose mouth its tail points at. 'narr' is the narrator's line (nature-documentary style: the golfer observed like wildlife) (spoken and shown). 'hook' opens the video and leads every caption; captions ask for a send or a tag (shares are the biggest reach signal).

episodes.title: The Golf Balls

panels.narr: Night falls. And the male golfer emerges... clutching his precious hoard.
He has found the perfect nest. The sock drawer. No predator would ever think to look here.
But the female... is never far away.
And, as so often in nature... she takes the spoils.

say.text: I'll take a sleeve. I'm playing Saturday.

episodes.title: The Rangefinder

panels.narr: Midweek. A parcel arrives at the burrow... while the male is away, foraging.
The female studies her prize. She can sense it. A rangefinder.
The male returns to the nest. And finds it... empty.
Remarkable. She has found the distance.
